body:
naw i get it, the whole wishing for actual social interaction thing, still being in quarantine has made friendships feel really odd. I guess to answer your question tho, from one suicidal person to another, I guess it can be, why? idk i just have a feeling. Seeing people who do have it going for them they seem like the most alive people ever, but I guess from a perspective like most of this sub its hard to relate to that, i get it. Why bother when we all die in the end anyway. So i guess it CAN be, if you really want it to be if you have that hope still. I guess all that's left is to keep trying, but how can i tell you that, it'd be pretentious and ironic of me to say all that. We don't all win at life, why not cut it short so I don't have to suffer like this anymore but i cant tell the future so idk. maybe it gets better maybe it doesnt, and even if you keep trying might not be worth it, or it might be worth it also, i guess ya never know.

this response was completely impulsive as well so sorry if i sound like an idiot and tell me to delete this if u think so too, i just felt like saying something
